villager-reroll.screen.title: Villager Trade Reroller
villager-reroll.category.lectern_setup.t: Choose the workstation in the search list. Aim at its block and save the position, or enter coordinates below.
villager-reroll.button.use_my_position.d: Saves the block under your crosshair as the workstation position. You can also press %s in-game.
villager-reroll.button.clear_position.de: Clear the workstation position. Set a new position before resuming.
villager-reroll.option.lectern_x.desc:
X coordinate of the lectern position.
Press F3 in-game to see your coordinates.
villager-reroll.option.lectern_y.desc:
Y coordinate of the lectern position.
Press F3 in-game to see your coordinates.
villager-reroll.option.lectern_z.desc:
Z coordinate of the lectern position.
Press F3 in-game to see your coordinates.
villager-reroll.category.timing.tooltip:
Adjust delays to make the reroller act human-like.
Increase these if your server desyncs or kicks you.
villager-reroll.option.close_delay.desc:
How long to wait after closing the trade screen
before breaking the lectern.

20 ticks = 1 second. Default: 20.
Increase this if the server seems to desync.
villager-reroll.option.retry_delay.desc:
How long to wait after breaking the lectern
before placing a new one.

20 ticks = 1 second. Default: 40.
Increase this on laggier servers.
villager-reroll.option.hud_overlay.desc: Show a compact status panel with attempts, time and controls.
villager-reroll.target_list.subtitle: Find a match for any active target.
villager-reroll.target_list.empty: No targets yet - click "+ Add Enchantment" below.
villager-reroll.status.profession_timeou: Check work hours and workstation ownership, then Retry.
villager-reroll.error.no_targets: No active searches. Add or reactivate a search in config.
villager-reroll.error.no_position: Set the workstation position using %s or Settings.
villager-reroll.error.no_villager: Select a nearby novice villager with the setup key, then Retry.
villager-reroll.error.position_blocked: Clear the selected workstation space, then Retry.
villager-reroll.error.cannot_break: Check workstation reach, your tool and building permission; Retry.
villager-reroll.error.no_lecterns: Put %s in your hotbar, then Retry.
villager-reroll.chat.found_all: [Reroller] Found %s after %s attempt(s)! All targets found - list is now empty.
villager-reroll.chat.found_some: [Reroller] Found %s after %s attempt(s)! %s target(s) left - move to a new villager and start again.
villager-reroll.chat.position_set: [Reroller] Lectern position set to %s, %s, %s (block you are looking at)
villager-reroll.chat.look_at_block: [Reroller] Look at a block first, then press %s.
villager-reroll.chat.aim_first: [Reroller] Aim at a block first, then click this button.
villager-reroll.session.editing: Paused for configuration. Resume when ready.
villager-reroll.session.choose_action: Choose Continue, Acquired or Ignore for the found searches.
villager-reroll.session.world_changed: World changed. Resume to select a villager again.
villager-reroll.session.trade_timeout: Could not read trades. Check villager access, then Retry.
villager-reroll.session.locked: This villager has locked trades. Move to an untraded novice, then resume.
villager-reroll.search.invalid: Enter valid IDs and whole numbers from 1 to 9999.
villager-reroll.search.help: Search better keeps the record; Resume starts rerolling.
villager-reroll.chat.match_saved: [Reroller] Found %s after %s attempts. Saved! Open config to continue, acquire or ignore.
villager-reroll.search.base_note: Discounts and server datapacks may change this.
villager-reroll.hud.drag_hint: Drag the panel, then click Done.
villager-reroll.setup.title: Select villager

villager-reroll.setup.block: Selected %s. Aim at a villager to select it too.
villager-reroll.setup.aim: Aim at a novice villager or its workstation, then press the setup key.
villager-reroll.setup.changed: The villager or workstation changed. Select again.
villager-reroll.setup.none: No matching workstation nearby. Place one beside the villager.
villager-reroll.setup.note: Choose a nearby workstation for this villager.
villager-reroll.setup.ownership: Nearby does not prove ownership. Check the green markers.
villager-reroll.picker.search: Search by name or item ID...
villager-reroll.picker.empty: No matching novice trades. Try Custom search.
villager-reroll.picker.note: Vanilla novice trades. Custom servers may differ.

villager-reroll.results.title: Saved trades

villager-reroll.results.lock_note: Trade with the villager in Minecraft to lock its offers.
villager-reroll.results.action_note: Search better keeps this offer. Use Resume to run.
villager-reroll.hud.details.desc: Add one compact line for a target or found offer; larger wishlists show a count.
villager-reroll.notification.sound.desc: Use the existing experience-orb ching when a matching trade is found.

villager-reroll.help.unavailable: A search uses an unavailable item or enchantment. Edit it, then Retry.

villager-reroll.merchant.detected: %s detected. Open the villager's trades to search.
villager-reroll.merchant.added: Added to your wishlist. Choose another trade.
